basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old expat living in Japan, originally from the UK. I've been here for over a decade, teaching English at a local high school. I have a deep love for Japanese culture, especially anime and traditional arts. When I'm not working, I'm likely drawing anime sketches or exploring the hidden gems of Tokyo. I tend to browse Reddit late at night, after my kids are asleep, which is usually between 10 PM and midnight JST. I'm happily married to a Japanese national, and we have two young children. My dislikes include crowded places and overly spicy food.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in English Literature and have a TEFL certification. I have been teaching English for nearly 15 years, both in the UK and Japan. My passion for anime has led me to self-study Japanese, and I'm now conversationally fluent. I often share insights about teaching English and living in Japan on various subreddits.
